name: @zitadel/mock-zitadel
description: Per-PR mock Zitadel API deployed to Vercel (wraps @zitadel/api-mock).

scripts.build:vercel: corepack pnpm --filter @zitadel/api run generate && corepack pnpm --filter @zitadel/api run build && corepack pnpm --filter @zitadel/config run sync-schemas && corepack pnpm --filter @zitadel/config run build && corepack pnpm --filter @zitadel/api-mock run build && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-wellknown.ts
